claims.value: `relation:guardian-1201` links minor River K. (`person:p-1201`) to guardian Dana K. (`person:p-1202`) from `source:guardian-form-r2`; the relation is `restricted_family`. The fact-scoped grant `authority:guardian-1201` controls River’s participation consent and sharing/export decisions, but cannot edit the official event schedule.

Sensitivity is field- and relationship-specific: `contact_email` (`river.k@example.com`) and `precise_handoff_place` are `restricted`; the display alias is `shareable`; the guardian relationship is `restricted_family`; and relationship notes and inferred assessments are excluded from public export.

The auditable projection is `projection:minor-public-1201`, based on `rev:personal-coordination-1201` and `schema:personal-coordination-source@v1`, under `policy:dependent-schedule@v3` for `audience:public` and purpose `public coordination brief`. It exposes alias `Participant R.` while redacting the internal ID, and includes occurrence `event-occurrence:field-lab-2026-08-16`, current time `2026-08-16T11:30:00-07:00`, timezone `America/Los_Angeles`, and consent `pending_guardian`. It withholds `/subject/internal_id` (`dependent_identity`), `/subject/contact_email` (`field_policy`), `/handoff/precise_place` (`dependent_location`), `/guardian/relationship_notes` (`relation_policy`), and `/subject/inferred_assessments` (`sensitive_inference`). The receipt was generated at `2026-08-11T23:35:00Z` as `audit:redaction-1201` from `source:projection-policy-r1`.

For `event-occurrence:field-lab-2026-08-16`, original time remains `2026-08-16T09:00:00-07:00`, current time is `2026-08-16T11:30:00-07:00` in `America/Los_Angeles`, and actual time remains `null`. The family artifact copied 09:00 on 2026-08-02 and remains a stale historical snapshot with `schedule_authority: none`, so it cannot rewrite the official schedule. Conversely, organizer authority cannot decide minor consent or sharing, while inferred assessments remain excluded as sensitive inference rather than becoming public facts.
